name: Pho cuon
summary: Phở cuốn is a roll wrapped in fresh rice-noodle sheets, the sheets usually cut into phở noodles, not dried rice paper. Vietnam Tourism says to look for grilled beef around Trúc Bạch.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s rolls article and Vietnam Tourism’s weekend itinerary both place it at Trúc Bạch.
howToEat: Eat the rolls on their own, or dip them in fish sauce with chili and calamansi.
Vietnam Tourism’s weekend itinerary puts the Ngũ Xã rolls in the evening, not at breakfast.
where: Ngũ Xã, Trúc Bạch. Vietnam Tourism’s rolls article says restaurants around the lake. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Pho cuon — Hanoi fresh noodle rolls
seoDescription: Phở cuốn in Hanoi is grilled beef in fresh rice-noodle sheets, around Trúc Bạch and on Ngũ Xã. Dip it in fish sauce with chili and calamansi.
